## Findings
- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] Extend coverage gate to ToolPage.tsx (largest untested behavior component)**
  - **Status quo:** `src/components/ToolPage.tsx` (1011 lines) renders all 17 tool detail pages and contains real interaction logic — product lookup by route, the consent-gated `tune_page_view` tracking effect, FAQ accordion state, copy-to-clipboard with timeout reset, and `proHint` string parsing — but has zero tests and sits outside the coverage gate (`vitest.config.ts:11-24`). It is the largest remaining behavior component after this cycle added consent/language/routing suites.
  - **Likely cause:** The gate widens per landed suite by design (see config comment); ToolPage is simply the next unlanded increment.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add a behavior-focused suite mocking `getProducts`/child components as in `App.test.tsx`: route→product match and "Tool not found" fallback, FAQ toggle, copy feedback, `getProFeaturesList` parsing edge cases, consent-gated tracking effect. Then add `src/components/ToolPage.tsx` to `coverage.include` and keep the 80% line threshold.
  - **Uncovered:** `src/components/ToolPage.tsx:41-50` (product match + tracking effect, in `ToolPage`), `src/components/ToolPage.tsx:63-71` (`toggleFaq` + `handleCopy`, in `ToolPage`), `src/components/ToolPage.tsx:74-90` (`getProFeaturesList` parsing, in `ToolPage`), remainder of the render branches in `ToolPage`
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / medium impact
